routes.purpose: Understand Apollo and try a clearly separate website learning exercise.

visual_hierarchy.decision: Direct educational promise, actual blue Discover capture, connected example, native comparison, breadth, FAQ and availability.
visual_hierarchy.check: Actual desktop/tablet/mobile renders, every section inspected.
visual_hierarchy.reason: Render inspection is not owner aesthetic acceptance.

usability.decision: Three example topics, distinct reasoning, explicit preview/confirm, valid and invalid quantity recovery.
usability.check: 29 focused assertions over actual browser receipts plus guard fixtures; negative control rejects wrong cash.

design_consistency.decision: Preserve selected Ascending A and exact blue/light palette; raw approved current app captures.
design_consistency.check: Computed palette, SVG path, loaded image checks and provenance.

motion.decision: Immediate user-controlled stage changes, no timed/ambient animation or autoplay.
motion.reason: No motion requirement or animated narrative; OS preference not independently exercised.

accessibility.decision: Semantic buttons/number label/details, visible focus, mobile grouping, error feedback.
accessibility.check: Keyboard selection, advance/confirm/focus return and four-width reflow checked.
accessibility.reason: Focused checks only. Full screen-reader, 200% zoom and physical-device browser certification NOT_RUN.

return_value.decision: No website save/account promise; exercise explicitly resets on reload.
return_value.check: Direct hash reload clears website practice.
return_value.reason: Native app persistence is outside marketing scope.

validation.decision: Product story should be comprehensible and feel stronger on mobile.
validation.check: Owner reviews the full rendered candidate; no comprehension study yet.
validation.reason: Owner aesthetic acceptance and user comprehension remain open.

journeys.reason: Website-only simulation; no app-account data or network orders.
